fields.Name: Everhour
fields.Description: Everhour time-tracking connector. Syncs team users, projects, per-project tasks and team-wide time records over the Everhour REST API v1.2 with an API-key credential. Read-only; money in cents and durations in seconds, as the vendor reports them.

fields.Name: Users
fields.Description: Members of the Everhour team, from the team-wide user listing. Read-only.

fields.Name: id
fields.Description: Everhour numeric user id. Primary key of this object and the value time records carry in their user field.

fields.Name: name
fields.Description: The user's full display name as a single string. Everhour stores no separate first/last name.

fields.Name: email
fields.Description: The user's email address.

fields.Name: headline
fields.Description: The user's job title or headline as shown in Everhour. Null when unset.

fields.Name: avatarUrl
fields.Description: URL of the user's avatar image. Null when the user has no avatar.

fields.Name: role
fields.Description: Team role: admin, supervisor or member.

fields.Name: status
fields.Description: Membership status: active, invited, pending or removed. Removed users keep returning here, so filter on this rather than assuming the listing is only current members.

fields.Name: Projects
fields.Description: Projects in the Everhour team, including those synced in from an upstream tool such as Asana or Jira. Read-only.

fields.Name: id
fields.Description: Everhour project id, carrying the source-platform prefix (e.g. "as:1234567890" for an Asana-backed project). Primary key of this object and the value substituted into the Tasks door — stored verbatim, prefix included.

fields.Name: name
fields.Description: Project name as shown in Everhour.

fields.Name: platform
fields.Description: Source-platform code parsed from the id prefix ("as" Asana, "jr" Jira, "ev" native Everhour, "tr" Trello, "gh" GitHub, ...). Derived by the connector, not returned as its own field; null when the id carries no prefix.

fields.Name: workspaceId
fields.Description: Id of the upstream workspace this project was synced from, with the same platform prefix. Null for projects created natively in Everhour.

fields.Name: workspaceName
fields.Description: Name of the upstream workspace this project was synced from. Null for native projects.

fields.Name: client
fields.Description: Numeric id of the client the project is billed to. Null when the project has no client. Soft reference to Everhour clients, which this connector does not sync.

fields.Name: type
fields.Description: Project layout type: board or list.

fields.Name: favorite
fields.Description: True when the project is starred by the calling user. This is per-API-key, not a team-wide property.

fields.Name: users_json
fields.Description: The project's assigned user id array serialized as JSON. Null when no users are assigned. Unbounded, so it cannot be a set of columns.

fields.Name: billing_type
fields.Description: Billing model, flattened from the nested billing object: non_billable, hourly or fixed_fee.

fields.Name: billing_fee
fields.Description: Fixed project fee in CENTS, flattened from billing.fee. Present only for fixed_fee projects. Vendor unit preserved — divide by 100 for currency.

fields.Name: rate_type
fields.Description: Rate model, flattened from the nested rate object: project_rate (one flat rate) or user_rate (per-member rates).

fields.Name: rate_rate
fields.Description: Flat project rate in CENTS per hour, flattened from rate.rate. Present only for project_rate projects. Per-user overrides are not columns; they are keyed by user id and land as custom data.

fields.Name: budget_type
fields.Description: Budget model, flattened from the nested budget object: money, time or costs.

fields.Name: budget_budget
fields.Description: Budget value, flattened from budget.budget. Unit follows budget_type: CENTS for money/costs budgets, SECONDS for time budgets.

fields.Name: budget_period
fields.Description: Budget periodicity: general (non-recurrent), monthly, weekly or daily.

fields.Name: budget_progress
fields.Description: Current budget usage, flattened from budget.progress. Same unit as budget_budget. Read-only in Everhour.

fields.Name: budget_time_progress
fields.Description: Portion of budget usage attributable to tracked time, flattened from budget.timeProgress.

fields.Name: budget_expense_progress
fields.Description: Portion of budget usage attributable to expenses, flattened from budget.expenseProgress.

fields.Name: budget_applied_from
fields.Description: Date a non-recurrent budget starts from, flattened from budget.appliedFrom. Null for recurrent budgets.

fields.Name: budget_threshold
fields.Description: Percentage (1-100) of the budget at which Everhour emails admins, flattened from budget.threshold.

fields.Name: budget_disallow_overbudget
fields.Description: True when Everhour blocks tracking beyond the budget, flattened from budget.disallowOverbudget.

fields.Name: budget_exclude_unbillable_time
fields.Description: True when non-billable time is excluded from budget progress, flattened from budget.excludeUnbillableTime.

fields.Name: budget_exclude_expenses
fields.Description: True when expenses are excluded from budget progress, flattened from budget.excludeExpenses.

fields.Name: Tasks
fields.Description: Tasks, fetched one project at a time. Everhour publishes no unfiltered team-wide task listing, so this is a templated child door over Projects.

fields.Name: id
fields.Description: Everhour task id, carrying the source-platform prefix (e.g. "ev:9876543210"). Primary key of this object, stored verbatim.

fields.Name: project_id
fields.Description: Id of the project this task was fetched under. Stamped by the engine from the parent record it iterated, not returned by Everhour on the task itself.

fields.Name: name
fields.Description: Task name as shown in Everhour.

fields.Name: description
fields.Description: Free-text task description. Null when the task has none.

fields.Name: project_ids_json
fields.Description: The task's own projects array serialized as JSON. A task can belong to several projects, so this can list more than the project_id it was fetched under.

fields.Name: section
fields.Description: Numeric id of the section the task sits in. Null when the task is in no section. Soft reference to Everhour sections, which this connector does not sync.

fields.Name: position
fields.Description: Ordering position of the task within its project or section.

fields.Name: labels_json
fields.Description: The task's label array serialized as JSON. Null when the task has no labels. Labels are free-form per workspace, so they cannot be columns.

fields.Name: dueAt
fields.Description: Task due date and time. Null when the task has no due date.

fields.Name: status
fields.Description: Task status: open or closed.

fields.Name: unbillable
fields.Description: True when time tracked against this task is marked non-billable.

fields.Name: time_total
fields.Description: Total time tracked against the task in SECONDS, flattened from time.total. Per-user breakdown is keyed by user id and is not a set of columns.

fields.Name: estimate_total
fields.Description: Task estimate in SECONDS, flattened from estimate.total. Null when the task has no estimate.

fields.Name: estimate_type
fields.Description: Whether the estimate is a single overall figure or per user, flattened from estimate.type.

fields.Name: attributes_json
fields.Description: Custom attributes carried over from the upstream integration, serialized as JSON. These are defined per workspace and per source tool, so they can never be declared columns.

fields.Name: metrics_json
fields.Description: Custom numeric metrics carried over from the upstream integration, serialized as JSON. Defined per workspace, so likewise not columns.

fields.Name: TimeRecords
fields.Description: Time records for the whole team from the team-wide door, filtered by date. Not a child of Projects — the team-wide endpoint returns the same records without an N+1 over projects.

fields.Name: id
fields.Description: Everhour numeric time record id. Primary key of this object.

fields.Name: time
fields.Description: Time recorded in SECONDS. Vendor unit preserved.

fields.Name: user
fields.Description: Numeric id of the user the time is recorded against. Matches Users.id.

fields.Name: date
fields.Description: The day the work happened. Drives incremental sync via the from/to window; note the record itself stays editable after this date, which is why the connector re-reads a lookback window.

fields.Name: comment
fields.Description: Free-text note on the time record. Null when none was entered.

fields.Name: isLocked
fields.Description: True when the record has been locked and can no longer be edited.

fields.Name: isInvoiced
fields.Description: True when the record has been included on an invoice.

fields.Name: task_id
fields.Description: Id of the task the time was tracked against, flattened from the nested task object. Null for time not attached to a task.

fields.Name: task_name
fields.Description: Name of the task the time was tracked against, flattened from the nested task object.

fields.Name: history_json
fields.Description: The record's edit history array serialized as JSON (who changed the duration, when, and by how much). Null when Everhour returned no history.
